title: Correct stale "~2s" fast-tier timing claim (real wall-clock ~7s) across process docs
description: hive-self-improve run (target: the development process; dimension: performance/doc-accuracy) measured the fast tier at 6.9-7.4s wall-clock, not the "~2s" the docs claim in four places: CLAUDE.md:72 ("pure logic, no real disk I/O (~2s)"), CLAUDE.md:97 ("the whole fast tier (~2s)"), CLAUDE.md:117 ("fast tier, ~2s"), and vitest.config.js:4/11 ("~2s" / "keeps the inner loop and deploy smoke at ~2s"). The "~2s" reflects test-EXECUTION time (vitest reports ~2.1s tests / ~2.9s collect / ~0.8s transform); wall-clock incl. vitest startup is ~7s. Because the per-ticket gate runs the fast tier twice (developer hand-off + reviewer re-verify), the stale figure understates per-ticket gate cost ~3x. Also: the cost is dominated by startup/collect which scales with spec-file count (71 fast specs today), so CLAUDE.md:117's "keeps per-ticket verification time roughly constant regardless of project age" and vitest.config.js:11's premise are drifting and should be softened to reflect that scoped test selection (test:changed/test:since), not the tier split alone, is what bounds inner-loop time. NOTE (measurement, do NOT act on it as a speedup): parallelizing the fast tier was tested and is WORSE on Windows — pool=threads 15.4s, forks singleFork=false 16.6s vs 7.0s baseline; only --no-isolate helped (~10%, 6.3s) at a shared-module-state correctness risk. So the fix here is doc-accuracy only, not a config change. Pure docs -> uat-only.
acceptance_criteria: CLAUDE.md's three '~2s' references (lines ~72, ~97, ~117) are corrected to distinguish ~2s test-execution from ~7s wall-clock (or updated to the honest wall-clock figure)
vitest.config.js's comment (~lines 4, 11) no longer claims the split alone 'keeps the inner loop ... at ~2s'; it credits scoped test selection for bounding inner-loop time
CLAUDE.md:117's 'roughly constant regardless of project age' is softened to acknowledge fast-tier startup/collect scales with spec-file count
No vitest config/pool change is made (measurement showed parallelism is ~2x slower on Windows); this ticket is documentation-only
UAT: a reader following the docs would budget the per-ticket gate realistically (~7s x2 fast tier) rather than ~2s
